pages.title: Noble Gas Clathrate
pages.text: A cage of ice with a xenon atom trapped in every cell, held not by bonds but by the plain fact that it cannot get out. The noble gases are supposed to be aloof; caged like this they are merely patient. It fizzes slightly as it warms.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Ice frozen around buckyball templates in superfluid helium formed cages of a very particular size. Noble gas filled them before I could seal the reactor, and stayed. Clathrates were not a goal - they were a pleasant accident.
